label: Colour contrast and link distinction
description: Darker light-theme link blue, a text-only accent colour that stays readable on the dark background, no opacity on the footer licence text, and underlined in-text links. Check the light theme links and the dark theme nav, date and footer.

label: Visible keyboard focus
description: A 3px focus ring in both themes (blue in light, yellow in dark). Press Tab in each frame and compare the indicator.

label: SkipTo skip-link menu
description: Vendored paypal/skipto 4.1.7. Press Tab once on any page, then Enter, in each frame.

label: Link hover and visited colours
description: Visited and hover colours for text links (4.5:1 or better in both themes); hover also thickens the underline. Hover a link in body text or the footer; visited needs a link you have opened.

label: Everything together
description: Upstream with all of the changes above merged. A merge conflict here fails the build, so it also shows whether the changes still fit together.
